name: session-meter
description: A band above the prompt: context forecast and turns left, prompt cache countdown, rate limits with their pace, a cache hit warning, cost, and stand-up / late-night reminders, fitted to the width. /meter shows the details.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: auto, 1h or 5m: how long the prompt cache lives after the last main-thread response. auto: 5m once a rate-limit window is spent (overage), else 1h. Anything else counts as auto. If you fix the TTL with an environment variable or promptCacheTtl, set this to match.

contextWarnPercent.title: Context warning (%)
contextWarnPercent.description: Warn when the context fills past this share of the window (or contextWarnTokens, whichever comes first). 0 turns the share off.

contextWarnTokens.title: Context warning (tokens)
contextWarnTokens.description: Warn at this many context tokens, again at twice it; turns left count toward it. Matters on 1M windows, where 80% comes far too late. 0 turns it off.

standupMinutes.title: Stand-up reminder (minutes)
standupMinutes.description: Remind you to get up after sitting this long; 10 minutes without a prompt counts as a break. 0 turns it off.

bedtimeHour.title: Late-night reminder (hour)
bedtimeHour.description: Toast once a night from this local hour until 5 am to wrap up. 0 turns it off.
